name: open-hangar
description: Browser extension that reads your own Star Citizen / RSI account data into a clean, reusable local database you can build on.

scripts.test: node --test test/parser.test.js test/scan.test.js test/htf.test.js test/value.test.js test/log.test.js test/profiles.test.js test/sanitize.test.js test/catalog.test.js test/org.test.js test/updates.test.js test/source.test.js test/qr.test.js test/referral.test.js test/resilience.test.js test/loaners.test.js test/store.test.js test/home.test.js test/status.test.js test/net.test.js test/buyback-details.test.js test/buyback-names.test.js test/db.test.js test/publish.test.js test/rates.test.js test/quips.test.js
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.pack: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --filename open-hangar-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename open-hangar-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
